title: Sequence-level inverse decoder prototype
decoder_rule: Detector bin gives local Fano fields; tick index gives frame; frame gives source/target; bin consistency validates the click.
summary: Prototype respects the no-pointwise-injection theorem: detector bin alone is local, while ordered tick context reconstructs source-target Witting transactions.
honesty_boundary: Deterministic schedule decoder only; no noisy multi-click batches or bench timestamps.
